hb260928enr-notes.to: Epic Ready to start, 3.45 days logged. Spike EP-55778 Done (original estimate 2 days, due 2026-08-25); its outcome is RFC-0010 (published 2026-09-23, status Draft, decision pending), which chooses a per-event, per-entity admin switch between ElasticSearch and AI search, with no fallback on AI failure (team discussion 2026-09-22). 2026-09-22 Oleksii Tur asked what the fallback should be if the AI endpoint returns nothing. First listing story EP-55996 (Exhibitors list) is Open, no estimate. Rollout phases P0 to P4 in the RFC; Exhibitors first, then one entity per change.
